query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `rulesLibrary` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `ruleCode` varchar(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text NOT NULL,
  `category` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `jurisdiction` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `municipality` varchar(100),
  `codeEdition` varchar(50),
  `nbcReference` varchar(100),
  `keywords` text,
  `applicableOccupancies` text,
  `applicableConstructionTypes` text,
  `isActive` boolean DEFAULT true,
  `isCustom` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `createdBy` int,
  `createdAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedBy` int,
  `updatedAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_jurisdiction` (`jurisdiction`),
  KEY `idx_category` (`category`),
  KEY `idx_ruleCode` (`ruleCode`)
);
